doc.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021

chapter: Pharaoh Sanders and the Theresa catalog
title: Pausing the interview and deciding to tell the Pharaoh Sanders story
summary: Rowe checks on fatigue, they discuss a part two, and Gordon offers the Pharaoh Sanders story.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Well Jerry, we’ve been at this for like quite a while, how are you feeling about it?
I’m okay. I guess I like to talk about myself I don’t know.

That’s good. I could see us keep talking on a part two if you’d like. Is there something you would like to add to what we’ve talked about today? We didn’t talk about Pharaoh Sanders. There’s a lot of other things we could mention.
And I have a lot more questions my own self.
You’re the tough one. Monk is easygoing. You’re the tough one.
Well let me suggest that maybe you could do a part two with Christian and continue some of those questions which I know that I couldn’t answer so I’d have to leave it up to you.
All right. Well if you guys want to continue fine. There’s nothing I’m really dying to say other than explain how I got Pharaoh Sanders on my label. Do you have time for that now or no?
We’d like to hear that, yes.
Yeah I have an hour or so, so I could probably ask my remaining questions, and the Pharaoh Sanders was one of them, if that’s all right with you, Monk.
